MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 1

2. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 8
   C. 49
   D. 24.5

3. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x
   D. 12x + 2

4. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.7
   C. 25
   D. 19.6

5. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 1/4
   C. 3/4
   D. 1/2

6. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 37
   C. 1
   D. 2

7. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.205
   B. 0.025
   C. 2.5
   D. 0.25

8. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 2

9. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x ≥ 0 only
   C. x = 5
   D. x < 5

10. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 1/2
   C. Cannot tell
   D. They are equal

11. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 27
   C. 27.6
   D. 33

12. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 45
   B. 30
   C. 18
   D. 36

13. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 22
   C. 28
   D. 33

14. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 37
   C. 31.6
   D. 31

15. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 15.6
   C. 15
   D. 21

16. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 1
   D. 2

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
